directive: Build a $0-stack pre-launch SEO, broken-link & security-header auditor for indie devs priced $9 one-time.

candidates.title: LaunchCheck — Zero-Subscription Pre-Launch SEO, Link & Security-Header Auditor
candidates.buyer_persona: Indie hackers, solo SaaS founders, and small web agencies shipping landing pages
candidates.recurring_pain: Shipping day-one launch bugs (broken links, missing OG/SEO tags, missing security headers) because enterprise SEO audit suites cost $49-$249/month.
candidates.current_workaround: Manually viewing page source or paying $99-$139/mo for bloated SEO suites
candidates.urgency_signal: Day-one launch traffic wasted on broken social cards, SEO tags, or security warnings

evidence.verbatim_quote: I built Shipcheck after seeing too many launches where small technical issues caused real problems on day one — broken links, slow pages, misconfigured SSL, missing security headers, DNS/email setup mistakes, etc.

I've been building CheckSitePulse, a website auditing tool that crawls sites and reports issues like broken links, spelling mistakes, accessibility problems, SEO issues, missing security headers, and content policy violations.
The main difference is it bundles a bunch of launch checks in one place like SEO metadata, sitemap/robots, security headers

competitors.main_gap: High monthly enterprise pricing for indie founders launching micro-sites.
